title: Signal vias off the In3 VBAT_PROT finger to U301
why: Seven new vias of SW_LHI, SW1_SNS and T1S_TERM_DROP stood on the 1.2 mm finger of In3 that feeds U301 and C301 (x 163.2 to 164.4, y 47 to 71) and cut it in three. Five go: SW1_SNS stays on In2 (spec s5i), the rest is routed again with a no-via zone over the finger. Q502's two in-pad vias stay (a B.Cu link under the part would cross T1S_TERM_COIL_S); they stand on the finger's west edge and leave it 0.75 mm.
